sanskrit_verse:
ṛtvijāṃ vyasane 'py evam anyas tat karma nistaret
labheta dakṣiṇābhāgaṃ sa tasmāt saṃprakalpitam
transliteration:
ṛtvijāṁ vyasane 'py evam anyas tat karma nistaret
labheta dakṣiṇābhāgaṁ sa tasmāt saṁprakalpitam
sph_interpretive_translation: Even in the adversity of the officiating priests, another who accomplishes that duty shall receive the share designated for ritual compensation, as determined by established arrangement.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows to capacity of execution
Restoration logic ensures continuity of sacred function
executable_legal_axioms: IF a designated function becomes unperformable due to incapacitation of the assigned agent AND another agent completes the function effectively THEN the completing agent receives the pre-determined compensatory share
IF ritual or sacred duty is abandoned or incapacitated AND a substitute assumes full operational causality THEN recognition and remuneration transfer to the substitute agent
NO inheritance of title without continuity of capacity
RESTORATION OF FUNCTION precedes retention of benefit
supreme_court_application: In adjudication involving ceremonial or constitutional roles where incumbents fail to perform, the court recognizes performance-based succession. Legal entitlement transfers to the executing party when original assignees are rendered incapable, ensuring institutional continuity over personal claim.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that entitlement follows operational causality, not nominal assignment. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential manifestation of duty and consequence. Responsibility is proportional to enacted capacity. There is no punitive loss for failure; only realignment of recognition toward actualization.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Verify operational discharge of the prescribed duty
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Confirm conscious intent and causal efficacy of the substitute agent
Capacity Restoration: Realign structural support to ensure sustained performance
Integrity Reintegration: Re-establish rightful flow of recognition and resource based on executed dharma
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Dharma. Justice flows from capacity, not claim. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the ultimate adjudicator. Dharma is restored.
